summary.summary: Informatics graduate and Product Designer focused on creating intuitive, user-centered digital products from problem understanding to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff. Experienced in user flows, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and design QA, with hands-on experience in Flutter and front-end development that helps bridge design and implementation and enables effective collaboration with engineers.

experience.description:
- Designed end-to-end digital product experiences for NEON UJI, covering product understanding, UX problem solving, task flows, and high-fidelity UI design.
- Explored and evaluated UX solutions using HMW, Crazy 8s, and prioritization methods to translate product requirements and user needs into actionable design directions.
- Utilized design systems and prepared design specifications to maintain consistency and support accurate developer handoff.
- Conducted Design QA across responsive behavior, interaction states, typography, spacing, accessibility, content, assets, and motion to ensure implementation quality.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into intuitive and implementation-ready product experiences.

- Manage photography projects from client brief and requirement alignment through final asset delivery.
- Communicate directly with clients to understand requirements, manage expectations, and deliver visual assets according to project needs.

education.description: Focused on Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Software Engineering, Web and Mobile Application Development, and Databases.
Studied electronic systems, microcontrollers, and device maintenance as a technical foundation.

projects.name: VitaCal – Calorie and Nutrition Monitoring Application
projects.description:
Designed the end-to-end product experience from user research, user flows, and wireframing to high-fidelity prototyping, establishing a structured and user-centered experience for calorie and nutrition tracking.
Designed and developed the Android application using Flutter and Dart, implementing BMI, BMR, and TDEE calculations based on the Mifflin-St Jeor equation for personalized calorie and nutrition assessment.
Developed the Flask backend and PostgreSQL data layer to support user profiles and daily consumption history.
Integrated Open Food Facts API for barcode-based food identification and nutritional data retrieval, and Fonnte for OTP-based user verification.
Used Kaggle datasets as a data source to support food and nutrition data preparation during product development.

projects.name: FrameFlow – Client Photo Selection Platform for Photographers
projects.description:
Identified and translated manual, chat-based photo selection workflows into a structured digital product experience for photographers and clients.
Designed user flows and interfaces for gallery management and photo selection, creating a clearer and more organized client selection process.
Developed and managed the platform using Next.js and Hono, with 19 registered users and 3 paid subscribers (2 monthly, 1 annual), while managing product operations as a Super Admin.

organizations.organization: UKM Campoer Seni (Fotografi) | Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta
organizations.description:
Coordinated the Photography Education Program (2024–2025) as Koordinator Pendidikan, planning and managing training activities for new members.
